'''Jarred Vanderbilt''' (born April 3, 1999) is an American [[basketball]] player. He played [[high school]] basketball for Victory Prep in Texas, and played men’s college basketball for the [[Kentucky Wildcats|University of Kentucky]]. In January 2017 Vanderbilt was selected as an [[2017 McDonald's All-American Boys Game|McDonald's All-American]].<ref>{{cite web | url = http://www.maxpreps.com/news/-c4H_udHpk68Wy2LGvrS3Q/2017-mcdonald’s-all-american-game-boys-rosters-announced.htm | title = 2017 McDonald’s All-American Game boys rosters announced | work = maxpreps | date = 15 January 2017 | accessdate = 20 February 2017}}</ref>

==Early life==
Vanderbilt was born in [[Houston, Texas]]. He is the son of Gwendolyn and Robert Vanderbilt. He has two older brothers, Jamal and Robert, and three older sisters, Rean, Jenae and Tasha. His father played basketball at Wiley College. His mother played at Xavier of Louisiana. His brother, Jamal, played at Texas-Tyler and sister, Jenae, played at UTSA.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.usab.com/basketball/players/mens/v/vanderbilt-jarred-1.aspx|title=Jarred Vanderbilt|website=www.usab.com}}</ref>

===Recruiting===
Vanderbilt is considered as one of the best players in the 2017 recruiting class by [[Scout.com]], [[Rivals.com]] and [[ESPN]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://247sports.com/Player/Jarred-Vanderbilt-29987|title=Jarred Vanderbilt, Victory Prep , Small Forward|website=247sports.com}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.espn.com/college-sports/basketball/recruiting/player/_/id/190952/jarred-vanderbilt|title=Jarred Vanderbilt - Basketball Recruiting - Player Profiles |publisher=ESPN}}</ref> On December 23, 2016 Jarred committed to the Kentucky Wildcats.

==National team career==
Won a gold medal with the 2015 USA U16 National Team at the [[2015 FIBA Americas Under-16 Championship]]. He scored 19 points in 19 minutes of play at the 2017 [[Nike Hoop Summit]], as Team USA defeated the World Select Team 98-87.<ref>{{Cite news|url=http://www.usab.com/news-events/live-stats/2017/usa-vs-world-select-team-2017.aspx|title=LiveStats - USA vs World Select Team - Nike Hoop Summit|access-date=2017-04-08|language=en-US}}</ref>
